name: thermal-emittance
description: The phase-space area a thermal packet occupies: position against divergence, which is the quantity that says whether a beam will fit through the next aperture. For a packet of transverse width sigma_x and thermal velocity spread sqrt(kT/m), drifting at speed v, the geometric emittance is sigma_x sqrt(kT/m) / v - 1.798 mm.mrad here. Optics can trade size against divergence and cannot reduce the product, so this is the number to compare sources by rather than a beam width.
